Resident Services
Resident Services
Auto Title
Easily manage your vehicle title needs in Franklin County. Whether you're transferring, registering, or requesting a duplicate, visit for quick, convenient services that help you stay on the road with ease.
Property
Find information from multiple county offices on property taxes, parcel search, real estate filings, and records search.
Dogs
Support the well-being of dogs by adopting, volunteering, or licensing your pet in Franklin County, and explore services, education, and lost and found resources.
Support & Assistance
Franklin County has many programs to help people in the community when they need it. These programs can help during tough times or when people want to learn new things.
Veterans
The Veterans Service Commission is a county agency dedicated to helping veterans, active duty members of the Armed Forces of the United States, and their dependents.
Seniors
The Office on Aging plans, coordinates, and provides centralized access to diverse services and programs that assist older adults, dependent adults, and their families in maintaining independent living.
Children & Youths
Explore programs designed to support youth and community well-being, including family stabilization, summer camps, youth engagement, and more.
Women & Infants
Franklin County houses a variety of resources and supportive services for women, parents, and infants.
Additional Community Resources
Find a wide range of community resources in Franklin County designed to support residents with services for health, housing, education, and more.
One Door
Franklin County One Door connects county health and human services in one place. One Door helps individuals while also looking at what other family members in the household might need.
